com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick

Interface HistoricalTickRecord<T>

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    HistoricalTickRecordCID<T>
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultHistoricalTickRecord, DefaultHistoricalTickRecordCID, PartialHistoricalTickRecordCID

    public interface HistoricalTickRecord<T>
    This tick data will be returned in the form of this object. The object could be initialized with a type of TradeTickRecord or QuoteTickRecord.

    One of the things to keep in mind is that getType method is provided in order to determine the type of tick record. If the tick request was made to get a response of both Quote and Trades then the tick records will be ordered by Timestamp. Thus it is becomes necessary to identify it using getType method before calling getValue method.

    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    QuoteTickRecord, TradeTickRecord
